answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn, with the stake slashed on proven misbehavior. Like a vertex where many paths meet, the stake is tied to one verified identity, so spawning a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand stakes. A garden of honest agents grows because each one earns its stake back with interest, while in the cold tundra of low-value tasks an attacker must still pay real capital per identity, making mass sybil creation unprofitable.
